title: Minimum wage rises to $7.50
detail: First of two steps set by AB 1835 (2006).

title: SB 3 signed: path to $15
detail: Schedule of yearly raises to $15 by 2022 for large employers (2023 for small), then yearly inflation adjustments.

title: New statewide ADU rules take effect
detail: SB 1069 and AB 2299 (2016) make it easier to build accessory dwelling units (backyard homes).

title: Prop 10 (rent control) fails
detail: Would have repealed the Costa-Hawkins limits on local rent control. About 59% voted no.

title: AB 1482 rent cap takes effect
detail: Tenant Protection Act: caps yearly rent increases on many older units at 5% plus inflation (max 10%) and adds just-cause eviction rules.

title: COVID-19 eviction freeze
detail: Judicial Council emergency rule pauses most eviction cases statewide.

title: COVID-19 Tenant Relief Act (AB 3088)
detail: Protects tenants who declare COVID-19 financial hardship; later extended by SB 91 and AB 832.

title: Prop 21 (rent control) fails
detail: Second attempt to expand local rent control. About 60% voted no.

title: Main state eviction protections end
detail: AB 832 protections expire; a rental-assistance pathway continues.

title: SB 9 lets owners split lots / build duplexes
detail: Allows up to two homes on many single-family lots, with lot splits.

title: Minimum wage reaches $15.50 for all employers
detail: SB 3 schedule complete; yearly inflation adjustments begin.

title: $20 fast-food minimum wage (AB 1228)
detail: Applies to workers at large fast-food chains only.

title: Props 32 and 33 fail
detail: Prop 32 ($18 minimum wage) and Prop 33 (expand local rent control, about 60% no) both rejected.
